ko.theme_desc: 달콤한 유혹에 빠진 인류, 붕어빵의 끈적한 촉수에 속절없이 사로잡히고 있다. 곧 붕어빵 공장에서 강제 노동을 하게 될지도.

scenarios.10y: 야, 붕어빵 군주님 맘에 들어서 붕어빵 갑옷 풀셋 맞췄대… 흑흑, 망했어.
scenarios.20y: 붕어빵 노예 탈출 작전을 돈으로 지원했는데, 알고 보니 붕어빵이 내 재산 불려줬대!
scenarios.30y: 붕어빵 왕국에 기부했더니, 붕어빵 행성 최고 부자로 임명됐다! 붕하!

en.theme_title: ⚠️ Warning: The Great Fish-Shaped Pastry Assimilation!
en.theme_desc: Humans are falling prey to the delicious allure of fish-shaped pastries, ensnared by their sticky embrace. Forced labor in the pastry factories looms.

scenarios.10y: Dude, he's wearing a full set of fish-shaped bread armor because the Fishy Overlord likes him… We're doomed.
scenarios.20y: He funded an escape from the fish-shaped bread slavery, only to find out it boosted his fortune!
scenarios.30y: Donating to the Fishy Kingdom got him the title of richest person on the Fish-Bread planet! Wahoo!
